messages:
Jamie (Support): heads-up — Ecotree Labs says they cannot accept an invoice without a signed purchase order and a short SOW. procurement@ecotree sent legal wording. attaching excerpt.
Kevin (Billing): ok. Do we have their company reg / VAT on file? If not, finance will refuse invoice posting.
Jamie (Support): they provided VAT: GB123456789. but procurement insists on a customer PO number + signature before we issue any invoice. quote_ref: RFQ-4493 attached.
Maria (Sales): cc @Kevin @Sam — Sales will need to send the signed SOW. I have an unsigned SOW draft. I can get signature but need a proforma invoice in the meantime for their procurement review. is that allowed?
Kevin (Billing): we can issue a proforma (non-posting) invoice for review purposes, but set billing_state=hold. we'll not generate a revenue invoice until we receive the PO. i'll create proforma_1972-EC and flag the account.
billing-bot: Proforma created: PF-1972-EC. Status: DRAFT. Linked ticket: #4521.
Jamie (Support): noted. forwarding proforma to procurement contact. they also want explicit line that "no services will be billed until PO is received" in the proforma.
Sam (Eng): FYI — no infra changes needed. if they want a delivery schedule in SOW, I can add a short paragraph about SLA and deployment windows.
Maria (Sales): i'll get SOW signed today. once signed, procurement will issue PO number. what's the canonical field for PO on our invoices so finance recognizes it?
Kevin (Billing): please ask customer to put PO number in the "Customer PO#" field and cc billing@redwood.ai. When PO arrives, reply-all with the signed PO PDF. we'll then convert PF to an official invoice: INV-1972-EC.
procurement-bot: Reminder: Customer PO required by enterprise policy. Any invoice posted without PO will be disputed by customer.
Jamie (Support): tagging @Maria — customer asked if we can accept emailed PO from procurement contact instead of the portal. is email sufficient?
Kevin (Billing): email PDF is fine, but must include signature and official PO number. scanned PO OK as long as it shows authorized signatory.
Maria (Sales): great — i will send SOW + proforma to procurement and follow up with a calendar invite. i'll update this thread when PO arrives.
Jamie (Support): closing loop for now. next steps: (1) Sales sends signed SOW, (2) Billing holds posting and creates proforma, (3) Customer sends signed PO PDF to billing@redwood.ai, (4) Billing converts PF->INV and releases billing. :thumbsup:
Maria (Sales): thanks — pinging again in 2 hours if no reply.
Jamie (Support): thanks everyone. logging steps to Zendesk ticket ZD-8527 and marking support escalation channel.
